<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C18H13O2), the DBE count, the presence of one carbonyl and one methyl group, the most plausible way to split the molecule is into a benzoyl fragment (phenyl‑C=O) and a tolyl fragment (phenyl‑CH3). These two neutral fragments can be joined at the carbonyl carbon to give the full structure. Their SMILES strings are “O=Cc1ccccc1” for the benzoyl part and “Cc1ccccc1” for the tolyl part.</thought>
<final_answer>['O=Cc1ccccc1', 'Cc1ccccc1']</final_answer>
